name: memory_reflect
description: Trigger a sleep consolidation (reflection) cycle. Reflection runs the full 14-relay cognitive pathway: episodic log consolidation, soul drift re-fusion, Hebbian homeostasis, synaptic pruning, temporal pruning, cross-layer promotion, procedural crystallization, entity maintenance, idiolect learning, and WAL journaling. Returns a detailed report of all work performed. Use this periodically (e.g., end of session) to promote episodic traces into long-term semantic memory and prune stale connections.

namespace.description: Target memory namespace (slug or ID). Omit to use connection or account default.

session_limit.description: Maximum number of episodic sessions to process. Omit for unbounded full cycle.

consolidation_only.description: If true, only run consolidation relays (skip companion maintenance like graph decay, entity cleanup). Faster but less thorough. Default: false.
